notes: Invented settlement names for Aethelgard. Woodland phonetics turned secretive and scholarly: harsh khr-/zh-/vkh-/gh-/sk- starts kept, but semantics shifted to hidden halls, frost, shadow, and lore-keeping (myrk dark, sval cold, skugg shadow, skhald lore-keeper, vard watch, skog deep wood, myr mire). Same North-Gale Woodlands dialect family as Krall, tuned away from raider bloodlust toward concealed research outposts and frost-forest watchtowers. The secret-base entrance displays as 'Unknown' in-world with all city info masked. NOTE: the names are intentionally swapped across the two slugs — slot c07 (slug 'thaurghend', SVG aethelgard_thaurghend.svg) is the masked 'Unknown' entrance, while slot c06 (slug 'unknown', SVG aethelgard_unknown.svg) displays as 'Thaurghend'. Do not 'fix' this by matching names to slugs; the geometry binding is deliberate. Not Amnek dictionary terms. Run scripts/audit-settlement-names.py before committing.
